summary: Osisko Gold Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a name change from Osisko Development Corp. to Osisko Gold Group Inc. and a change in registered office province from Quebec to Ontario, effective July 14, 2026. The change was approved by shareholders on June 23, 2026. Trading symbol on TSX and NYSE changed from ODV to OGG; warrant symbols also changed. The filing is an administrative corporate restructuring with no deal consideration, premium, or financial terms. As a routine name and domicile change with no special-situation event, it is classified as None.
